=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:683-721, 1752-1755 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The intake builds the provenance-trusted scope marker from paths extracted from model-generated diagnosis text influenced by untrusted issue text and failure evidence.
  WHY: Provenance verification establishes who authored the issue body, not that its model-derived paths came from a trusted source, so an attacker can steer the model to authorize edits to a chosen eligible repository path.
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:72-73, 139-145; scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:410-414 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The protected root instruction-file list omits ai_pipeline.md, and the canonical-source check in the implement commit guard checks deletions but not modifications.
  WHY: A staged modification to ai_pipeline.md can pass the independent protected-path check and the deletion-only canonical-source guard.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:671-679 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: is_exact_scope_path accepts glob metacharacters in paths such as scripts/*.py, which the scope guard interprets as patterns.
  WHY: The scope guard can match files beyond the exact path intended; severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated this BLOCKER, while minimax_minimax-m3 and qwen_qwen3_7-plus rated it MAJOR.
- changelog.d/6221-heal-evidence-editor-isolation.md:entire file | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The reported deletion of the issue #6221 changelog fragment would prevent its shipped security fix from being included by the changelog assembler.
  WHY: Without the fragment, the next release would omit documentation for the separate editor-isolation security fix; severity disagreement: qwen_qwen3_7-plus rated this BLOCKER, while google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite and minimax_minimax-m3 rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:671-680 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: is_exact_scope_path requires a basename with a non-empty stem and extension, rejecting valid extensionless files such as Makefile and Dockerfile.
  WHY: A legitimate scope path for an extensionless file is filtered out, causing the repair to be blocked or omitted from the allowlist.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- requirement: Protect “the root instruction files” independently of the allowlist.
  expected_change_site: scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py::HEAL_PROTECTED_ROOT_FILES / is_heal_protected_path
  confidence=[5]
